cluster_commentary.draft: The perturbation sector contains the distinctive EFC signatures — non-monotonic lensing (P1), gravitational-slip enhancement (P3), and the Horndeski no-go (P5). All three are structural discriminators: they cannot be mimicked by ΛCDM + nuisance parameters. As of 2026-04-23 (DOI 32084670), the growth-sector closure proves there are no free parameters remaining: P3 is now a theorem of EFC, not a tuning. Stage-IV tomography (Euclid DR1, SO × Euclid) is required to test them.

P2 (fσ8 at z=0.7) and P4 (Rubin DP2 S8) are DAMAGE-class: failure erodes motivation without falsifying the framework. Both are quantitative point predictions with explicit ΛCDM comparison. As of 2026-04-26 (DOI 32101213), the underlying α-parameter is independently constrained to α ∈ [−0.72, −0.68] via three orthogonal channels (SPARC175, NUTS BAO+Hz, non-MCMC analytic). P4 is also testable via the formal RCMP DES Y6 + KiDS Legacy protocol (DOI 32080083, 2026-04-22).
P5 (Horndeski no-go) and P6 (background sign lemma) are closed — either analytically proven or exhaustively scanned. They are listed for completeness, not as open tests.

P7 (H0 three-window decomposition, DOI 32113399, 2026-04-28) reframes the Hubble tension as a structural consequence of regime-mixing, not a free-parameter degeneracy. Planck, DESI BAO, and SH0ES probe distinct regime windows (L0/L1/L2) that EFC predicts must NOT coincide. Atlas role upgraded from addresses_open to proposes_resolution on 2026-04-29.

P8 (bar-instability falsification, DOI 32101111, 2026-04-26) is EFC's sole monopoly phenomenon in the atlas. Among 43 frameworks (ΛCDM, MOND, Verlinde, f(R), DGP, etc.) NONE provide an explicit bar-instability criterion. EFC replaces the falsified Efstathiou-Lake-Negroponte criterion with Π_EFC = σ_R·κ_eff/(3.36·G·Σ) < 1 incorporating an entropy-gradient correction to κ². Cross-population test against SPARC + S4G + Galaxy Zoo is pre-registered.
